metadata.title: Energy Broker Lead Database - ENR Top Contractors (Remaining)
metadata.description: Contact and company data for ENR Top 50 general contractors in North America not previously covered
metadata.source_ranking: ENR 2026 Top 400 Contractors List (based on 2025 revenue data)

leads.enr_ranking_note: Top 5 ENR 2026; Fortune 500 (#288)
leads.sustainability_commitments: Achieved Net Zero Scope 1 & 2 emissions in 2023. Committed to 30% Scope 1 and 25% Scope 2 reduction from 2017 baseline by 2030. Transitioning fleet to electric vehicles, installing solar panels on offices, switching to LED lighting and renewable energy.
leads.electric_equipment_notes: Fleet transitioning to EVs; offices switching to renewable energy and solar power generation; upgrading fleet vehicles to electric as part of post-2025 sustainability strategy.
leads.key_operating_regions: Global: North America, South America, Europe, Middle East, Africa, Asia-Pacific. Major US presence in TX, CA, SC, and project sites nationwide.
leads.specialties: Engineering, procurement, construction (EPC); energy, chemicals, mining, infrastructure, government services

leads.enr_ranking_note: Top 10 ENR; major infrastructure and design firm
leads.sustainability_commitments: Net zero by 2040 (SBTi-approved). Near-term: 60% reduction in Scope 1 & 2 by 2030; 50% reduction in Scope 3 by 2030. Long-term: 90% reduction all emissions by 2040. Sustainable Legacies strategy across all operations.
leads.electric_equipment_notes: Decarbonizing fleet vehicles; installing EV chargers at leased offices; 50% reduction in business travel emissions; switching to renewable energy tariffs company-wide.
leads.key_operating_regions: Global: 150+ countries. Major US offices in Dallas, Los Angeles, New York, Denver, Chicago. Also strong in UK, Australia, Canada, Middle East.
leads.specialties: Infrastructure, environmental services, transportation, water, energy, program management

leads.enr_ranking_note: Top 10 ENR; global technology-forward solutions company
leads.sustainability_commitments: Net zero across entire value chain by 2040. Near-term: 50% reduction Scope 1 & 2 by 2030 (baseline 2019). 65% of suppliers by spend to have SBTs by 2025. 50% cut in Scope 3 business travel and commuting. SBTi Corporate Net-Zero Standard approved (2022).
leads.electric_equipment_notes: Achieved 100% low-carbon electricity globally. Focus on electrification solutions for clients including energy efficiency, renewable energy, and supply chain decarbonization.
leads.key_operating_regions: Global: North America, Europe, Middle East, India, Australia, UK. Major US offices in Dallas, Houston, Denver, Atlanta, Philadelphia, Pasadena.
leads.specialties: Critical infrastructure, advanced facilities, cybersecurity, environmental, transportation, water, energy transition consulting

leads.enr_ranking_note: Top 10 ENR; one of the largest privately held GCs in the US
leads.sustainability_commitments: Perennial ENR Top 20 Green Contractor. Champions sustainable building practices as core company value. Focus on LEED, WELL, and other green certifications across all project types.
leads.electric_equipment_notes: Industry leader in sustainable building construction; green building practices applied regardless of client certification goals. Details on fleet electrification not publicly available.
leads.key_operating_regions: Nationwide US coverage with 50+ offices. Major presence in Mid-Atlantic (MD, VA, DC), Northeast (NY, NJ, CT, MA), Southeast (FL, GA, NC), Southwest (TX), and West Coast (CA).
leads.specialties: General contracting, construction management, design-build; commercial, healthcare, education, data centers, life sciences

leads.hq_address: 1341 N Rock Hill Rd, St. Louis, MO 63124
leads.enr_ranking_note: Top 20 ENR; 100% employee-owned; leader in renewable energy construction
leads.sustainability_commitments: Industry leader in utility-scale renewable energy construction. Completed 800 MW Double Black Diamond Solar facility in Illinois. Active in solar and wind generation projects nationwide. Dedicated renewables team led by aerospace executive.
leads.electric_equipment_notes: Major builder of solar and wind farms; Red Rock Solar Plant and similar utility-scale projects. Focus on renewable energy infrastructure construction as growth area.
leads.key_operating_regions: National US: Midwest (MO, IL, KS), Southwest (TX, AZ, NV), West Coast (CA), Southeast (GA, FL, NC). Regional offices in Phoenix, Dallas, Houston, Atlanta, Las Vegas, San Francisco, Sacramento, Newport Beach.
leads.specialties: General contracting, design-build, renewable energy construction, healthcare, education, commercial, science & technology, water/wastewater

leads.enr_ranking_note: Top 25 ENR; privately held commercial contractor
leads.sustainability_commitments: Supports clients' sustainable initiatives including LEED, WELL, Green Globes certifications. Proactively assists clients with education, options, and solutions for green building. Focus on building efficiency and environmental stewardship.
leads.electric_equipment_notes: Expertise in MEP systems including building automation, power monitoring, and commissioning. Focuses on efficient equipment procurement and operational support for sustainable buildings.
leads.key_operating_regions: Southeast and national US: Atlanta (HQ), Charlotte, Columbus, Dallas, Denver, Phoenix, San Jose, Washington DC.
leads.specialties: Construction management, design-build, preconstruction, MEP self-perform; data centers, healthcare, higher education, commercial office, mission critical

leads.enr_ranking_note: Top 15 ENR; one of the largest privately held GCs in the US
leads.sustainability_commitments: Active in healthcare, education, energy, and aerospace facility construction. Green building experience across diverse market sectors.
leads.electric_equipment_notes: Broad construction capabilities including energy sector projects; specific electric equipment commitments not publicly detailed.
leads.key_operating_regions: Southeast US: Alabama (HQ), Georgia, Florida, Tennessee, North Carolina, South Carolina, Texas, Virginia, Washington DC. 13 office locations.
leads.specialties: General contracting, design-build, construction management; healthcare, commercial, education, industrial, government, water/wastewater

leads.hq_address: 330 West 34th Street, 12th Floor, New York, NY 10001
leads.enr_ranking_note: #3 on ENR 2026 Top 400 (up from #6 prior year)
leads.sustainability_commitments: Tracks embodied carbon in materials and construction process impacts (fuel, transportation, water, waste). Uses Green Badger platform for ESG tracking and LEED compliance. Published ESG Report with goals for social, environmental, and ethical responsibility.
leads.electric_equipment_notes: Built Columbia University's first all-electric academic research lab in NYC. MEP capabilities include mechanical, electrical, life safety systems. Focus on sustainable building systems integration.
leads.key_operating_regions: North America, Europe, Asia, Middle East. Major US presence in New York, New Jersey, Mid-Atlantic, Southeast, Southwest. Subsidiary companies include Structure Tone, Pavarini McGovern, Ajax Building, Govan Brown.
leads.specialties: Construction management, general contracting, design-build; commercial, healthcare, mission-critical, institutional, interior fit-out

leads.enr_ranking_note: Top 20 ENR; US subsidiary of Balfour Beatty plc (UK)
leads.sustainability_commitments: Beyond Net Zero by 2040 (group target). 88% of cars alternatively fueled; 15% full BEV. Three-pronged decarbonization: efficiency, electrification, alternative fuels. 70% of Scope 1 emissions from fuel for plant/fleet/generators. EcoNet technology reducing on-site carbon by up to 80%.
leads.electric_equipment_notes: Active electric fleet transition: electric LCVs on order; car choice list turning all-electric during 2025. 46% BEV models on choice list. Electric car salary sacrifice scheme for all employees. Pioneering hydrogen-powered engine cleantech for rail plant.
leads.key_operating_regions: National US: Texas (HQ), Southeast, Mid-Atlantic, Florida, California, North Carolina. Also UK operations through parent company. Infrastructure, buildings, and services divisions.
leads.company_type: Private (subsidiary of Balfour Beatty plc, LSE: BBY)
leads.specialties: Buildings, infrastructure, services; healthcare, education, commercial, transportation, military, water

leads.enr_ranking_note: Largest specialty contractor by revenue; ENR top-ranked for electrical/infrastructure
leads.sustainability_commitments: Major platform for energy transition, grid reliability, and communications infrastructure. Acquired Blattner Holding (utility-scale renewables leader): 300+ wind projects (49 GW), 90+ solar projects (12 GW), 17 energy storage projects. Strategic investments in renewable energy infrastructure.
leads.electric_equipment_notes: Core business is electric power transmission and distribution infrastructure. Blattner subsidiary is one of North America's largest utility-scale renewable energy EPC providers. Directly enabling grid electrification and renewable power generation at massive scale.
leads.key_operating_regions: North America, Australia. Nationwide US coverage with concentration in TX, CA, FL, Midwest, Northeast. Operations in Canada and select international markets.
leads.specialties: Electric power T&D, renewable energy EPC, natural gas/oil pipeline, telecommunications, industrial services

leads.hq_address: 800 S. Douglas Road, 12th Floor, Coral Gables, FL 33134
leads.enr_ranking_note: Top 15 ENR specialty/infrastructure contractor
leads.sustainability_commitments: Expanding capabilities to support energy transition to renewable sources. Combined electrical T&D and renewable power generation services for complete energy transition support. Helping customers reduce carbon emissions through infrastructure modernization.
leads.electric_equipment_notes: Electrical T&D construction is a core service line. Expanded renewable power generation services (wind, solar). Complete suite of services supporting power generation and grid infrastructure for energy transition.
leads.key_operating_regions: Nationwide US and Canada. HQ in South Florida; major operations across all US regions. Strong presence in pipeline, T&D, and renewables markets throughout North America.
leads.specialties: Infrastructure engineering/construction; electrical T&D, pipeline, renewable energy, telecommunications, clean energy

leads.enr_ranking_note: Top 20 ENR; 100% employee-owned; major E&C firm
leads.sustainability_commitments: Pledged net-zero GHG emissions by 2025. Ended coal-based power design/construction to focus on clean energy. Signed three UN pledges (Global Compact, CEO Water Mandate, Caring for Climate). Accelerate Zero sustainability strategy. IgniteX clean tech startup accelerator. Signed UK Powering Net Zero Pact.
leads.electric_equipment_notes: Major focus on advancing renewable energy and energy storage technologies. Deploying hydrogen as carbon-free fuel at scale. Carbon capture technology development. Planning $1.34B new headquarters and mixed-use district in Kansas.
leads.key_operating_regions: Global: 100+ countries. Major US presence in Kansas City metro (HQ), nationwide project sites. Strong in power, water, telecommunications, and government services markets worldwide.
leads.specialties: Engineering, procurement, consulting, construction; electric power, water, telecommunications, government, oil & gas, mining

leads.enr_ranking_note: Top 15 ENR; 100% employee-owned; major EPC firm
leads.sustainability_commitments: Leading role in UK Net Zero grid infrastructure alongside National Grid. GHG emissions accounting and reduction strategies for clients (Scope 1, 2, 3). Sustainability services including permitting and emissions control. Single point of contact for energy diversification projects.
leads.electric_equipment_notes: Works with utilities, transit agencies, and fleet operators on transportation electrification. Solutions for solar, wind, hydro, biomass, biofuels, electrification, hydrogen, and ammonia. Focus on realistic, data-driven fleet electrification strategies.
leads.key_operating_regions: Global: 60+ offices worldwide. Nationwide US presence with HQ in Kansas City. Strong in power/energy, water, environmental, federal, aviation, and industrial markets.
leads.specialties: Engineering, construction, architecture; electric power generation, T&D, environmental, aviation, oil & gas, process/industrial

leads.hq_address: 2300 N Field Street, Suite 1900, Dallas, TX 75201
leads.annual_revenue: $7.5 billion (trailing 12 months as of Q1 2026; $6.4B FY 2024)
leads.enr_ranking_note: Top 20 ENR; growing rapidly in energy and infrastructure
leads.sustainability_commitments: Energy segment provides EPC and maintenance for renewable energy, energy storage, renewable fuels, and petrochemical industries. Positioned for energy transition with diversified energy services portfolio.
leads.electric_equipment_notes: Active in renewable energy and energy storage construction. Growing presence in renewable fuels infrastructure. EPC capabilities for solar, wind, and battery storage projects.
leads.key_operating_regions: Nationwide US and Canada. HQ in Dallas; operations concentrated in Texas, California, Southeast, and major pipeline/energy corridors across North America.
leads.specialties: Infrastructure services; pipeline, industrial, renewables, power delivery, civil, environmental

leads.enr_ranking_note: Top 15 ENR; leading civil and building contractor
leads.sustainability_commitments: Green building services including LEED certification. Strict adherence to environmental regulations on project sites. Reduces energy usage through building efficiency and renewable energy integration. Material selection for indoor air quality. Published ESG Summary reports.
leads.electric_equipment_notes: Deployed Tier 4 off-road construction equipment (highest US emission standards) on California High-Speed Rail. Solar PV integration on US Army projects. Acquired GreenStar Services (electrical/mechanical services provider).
leads.key_operating_regions: Nationwide US. Major presence in California (HQ), Northeast (NY, NJ, CT), Southeast, Southwest. Active in civil/heavy infrastructure, building, and specialty markets. California High-Speed Rail contractor.
leads.specialties: Civil/heavy construction, building construction, specialty contractors; transportation, healthcare, hospitality, gaming, water/wastewater

leads.enr_ranking_note: Top 25 ENR for heavy civil; subsidiary of Hochtief/ACS Group
leads.sustainability_commitments: Focus on heavy civil infrastructure including transportation and bridge projects. Parent company Hochtief has broader sustainability commitments.
leads.electric_equipment_notes: Specific electric equipment commitments not publicly detailed. Focus is on major civil infrastructure (highways, bridges, tunnels, dams) where equipment electrification is emerging.
leads.key_operating_regions: Western and Central US primarily. Colorado (HQ), California, Washington, Texas, and select major infrastructure projects nationwide. Also Canada through Dragados partnership.
leads.company_type: Private (subsidiary of Hochtief AG / ACS Group)
leads.specialties: Heavy civil construction; highways, bridges, tunnels, dams, light rail, airports, water infrastructure

leads.hq_address: 300, 10220 103 Avenue NW, Edmonton, AB T5J 0K4, Canada
leads.enr_ranking_note: Top 10 ENR for design firms; major presence in North America
leads.sustainability_commitments: Carbon neutral for 4 consecutive years. 68% of revenue (C$5.5B) from sustainability-aligned work. Exceeded Scope 1 & 2 emissions target (70% reduction) as of 2025. 97% of electricity from renewables. CDP A- score for 8 consecutive years. Net Zero Challenge participant.
leads.electric_equipment_notes: Supported design of carbon-neutral manufacturing facility with hydro-powered electric kilns (9,000 tonnes CO2e reduction annually). Engineering services for electrification and renewable energy projects for clients.
leads.key_operating_regions: Global: 400+ locations in 6 continents. North America primary: Canada (HQ), US (major offices in NY, Boston, Denver, Phoenix, LA). Also UK, Australia, New Zealand, Middle East.
leads.specialties: Engineering, architecture, environmental consulting; infrastructure, water, energy, buildings, environmental, transportation

leads.sustainability_commitments: Committed to sustainability through multidisciplinary collaboration. Focus on creating sustainable, resilient solutions with long-term positive community impacts. Design and consulting services for climate resilience and sustainability across infrastructure sectors.
leads.electric_equipment_notes: Engineering and consulting services for energy transition, electrification, and sustainable infrastructure. Client advisory services on decarbonization and clean energy systems.

leads.hq_address: 2900 Fairview Park Drive, Falls Church, VA 22042
leads.enr_ranking_note: Top 10 ENR 2025 (jumped from #26 to #10); one of fastest-growing GCs
leads.sustainability_commitments: Committed to carbon neutrality (target was 2023). 200+ LEED-certified projects delivered. LEED Gold corporate headquarters. ~300 LEED projects handled by sustainability department. Green construction best practices applied to all projects regardless of client certification goals.

Investigating more efficient operations for tower cranes and other equipment. Day-shift housekeeping to reduce evening electrical consumption.

leads.enr_ranking_note: Top 25 ENR; employee-owned; strong West Coast presence
leads.sustainability_commitments: Delivers LEED, Net Zero Energy, WELL, Living Building Challenge, and Net Zero Carbon certifications. Swinerton Energy subsidiary: EPC for renewable natural gas and clean energy. Built Oregon Zoo electrification project replacing natural gas with electric systems. 100 kW solar + battery storage at SF headquarters.
leads.electric_equipment_notes: Oregon Zoo project: replaced natural gas heating with high-efficiency electric equipment + solar panels. HQ solar + battery system reduces grid reliance. Swinerton Energy division focused on clean energy EPC. Built one of largest CLT manufacturing facilities and first mass timber CSU building. Investments in environmentally beneficial construction technologies.
leads.key_operating_regions: Western US primarily: California (SF HQ, LA, San Diego, Sacramento), Oregon, Washington, Hawaii, Colorado, Texas, North Carolina. Swinerton Energy has national reach.
leads.specialties: General contracting, construction management, design-build; commercial, healthcare, education, renewable energy, mass timber, self-perform concrete/drywall

leads.hq_address: 207 King Street, Suite 300, San Francisco, CA 94107
leads.enr_ranking_note: ENR Top 100; California's premier commercial builder
leads.sustainability_commitments: 100 LEED-certified buildings completed; 75% achieving Platinum or Gold. ENR Top 100 Green Builders (#16 in 2021). Built world's first TRUE Zero Waste for Construction-certified project (98.4% diversion). Member: Carbon Leadership Forum, USGBC-CA, Bay Area Sustainable Construction Leaders.
leads.electric_equipment_notes: Shifted fleet to electric vehicles (fleet was 60%+ of Scope 1/2 footprint). Built 300 Kansas - SF's first all-electric, zero-carbon, ILFI-certified core & shell building. SFO Harvey Milk Terminal 1 - world's first dual LEED v4 Platinum + WELL Platinum airport project. Every project has a 'Sustainability Champion.'
leads.key_operating_regions: California: San Francisco (HQ), Alameda, San Jose, Los Angeles, San Diego.
leads.specialties: Commercial construction, preconstruction, building services; mixed-use, commercial, civic/cultural, education, hospitality, life sciences

leads.enr_ranking_note: Major specialty contractor in electrical infrastructure
leads.sustainability_commitments: Leading provider of turnkey solutions for electric power infrastructure. Core business directly supports grid modernization and electrification of the energy system.
leads.electric_equipment_notes: Core business is electric power network construction and maintenance. Infrastructure services for electric T&D, natural gas, and telecommunications networks. Directly enabling utility grid expansion and modernization.
leads.key_operating_regions: Eastern US primarily: North Carolina (HQ), Southeast, Mid-Atlantic, Northeast. Growing national presence in electric power and telecommunications infrastructure.
